g.aria-label: McAllester–Stratos Theorem (2020): Any 95% Distribution-Free Lower Bound B(Sₙ) ≤ O(log n)
Pr(collision in n draws of M) ≤ n²/(2M)
2. Test on M = n² Uniform Symbols
H(X) = 2 log n ⇒ Pr(B ≤ 2 log n) ≥ 0.95
Outputs ≤ 2 log n on ANY distinct sample!
At n = 10⁶ samples: 2 ln n = 27.6 nats max certificate, even when true H = 177 nats (256-bit keys)!
